text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This super long race is about to start…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Spe! The day's finally here!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It won't be the end of the world if you lose, so don't be too hard on yourself…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, who am I kidding? Neither of us would be where we are now if we thought losing was okay.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohoho! Is that a challenge? I see you're the same Spe as always.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'll accept your challenge and take you head-on… at least for today.
